items.title: Adobe Campaign Classic CVSS 10.0 Flaw Could Run Code Without User Interaction
items.description: Adobe has released security updates to address a maximum-severity security flaw in Campaign Classic (ACC), its enterprise-focused marketing automation platform, that could result in arbitrary code execution. items.title: Hijacked Hotel Wi-Fi Pushes Fake Updates to Deliver Surveillance Malware
items.description: A fake browser update served over hijacked hotel Wi-Fi has been used to deliver CornFlake, a remote access trojan (RAT) that can capture webcam images, microphone audio, and keystrokes, Microsoft said in its latest report. items.title: ZDI-CAN-33064: LangGenius
items.description: A CVSS score 6.5 AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N severity vulnerability discovered by 'Taha Siddiqi (@_atomiz_) of TrendAI Research' was reported to the affected vendor on: 2026-08-01, 0 days ago. The vendor is given until 2026-11-29 to publish a fix or workaround. Once the vendor has created and tested a patch we will coordinate the release of a public advisory.

items.title: Arch Linux Disables AUR Package Takeovers as Attackers Push Malicious Commits
items.description: Arch Linux has temporarily disabled package adoption on its Arch User Repository (AUR) after security teams detected a wave of malicious takeovers and follow-up commits designed to compromise unsuspecting users. items.title: HackerOne Mandates ID Verification for Bug Bounty Submissions
items.description: HackerOne has confirmed that all hackers must now complete identity verification before submitting reports to any bug bounty program (BBP) on its platform, a move the company says is necessary to meet regulatory requirements. The policy distinguishes bug bounty programs from vulnerability disclosure programs (VDPs), which remain open to unverified researchers since no monetary reward […] The…
